taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: RDP gateway identity, resource authorization and session lifecycle
controls.source_trace: Trace authenticated identity and approved target into the actual remote-session connection, including aliases and reconnect state.
controls.implementation_branch: Distinguish gateway connection authorization, resource authorization and target host login. Passing one gateway policy does not establish access to every internal host or desktop session. Follow user/group conditions, selected resource and any session reconnection policy using supplied configuration or a lab, and preserve target authentication as a separate necessary edge.
controls.controlled_verification: Use owned lab targets or configuration proof with synthetic identities; compare an entitled target and one forbidden target/resource alias.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Gateway login or target discovery is not a desktop session; denial before connection is a meaningful control.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind connection/resource policy to normalized targets and verify permitted reconnect and revocation.
